Myanmar conflict death toll exceeds 100,000 since 2021 coup

A monitoring group reports that over 100,000 people have been killed in Myanmar since the military coup in 2021. The coup ousted the elected government, leading to widespread civil conflict. Activists have joined guerrilla groups and ethnic armies to fight against the ruling military junta.
